gaps.summary: Deployable production composition is not yet activated.
gaps.detail: The Tool Gateway contracts now compose deterministically with the current NODE-20 SideEffectGateway and expose narrow NODE-21/NODE-18/NODE-16 boundaries, but the production API/service bootstrap has not yet installed the complete authenticated permission-context + durable SideEffectGateway + trusted offloader + sandbox client graph.

gaps.summary: Production native handler and result-offloader bindings remain open.
gaps.detail: The P0 catalog and adapter ports exist for Asset, Project, Artifact, Sandbox and Media. Production domain handlers and NODE-18 trusted large-result offloader/object-store composition are not activated in this node.

gaps.summary: Hosted GitHub Actions cannot currently allocate a runner.
gaps.detail: The repository account payment/spending-limit condition prevents hosted jobs from starting. No pytest, Ruff, Pyright, integration or security PASS is claimed until a real runner executes the NODE-25 workflow.
